claims.statement: Normalization policy identity is content-bound by a canonical digest; a symbolic profile_ref alone cannot satisfy policy identity.

Each normalization resource profile separates required container-presence semantics from required/optional selected field paths, with explicit non-overlap and omission semantics preventing implicit subtree inclusion.
The historical HAK-007 source observation remains RetrospectiveUnbound and cannot be upgraded to a content-bound or precommitted normalization claim without additional evidence.
Canonical policy and observation-binding digests detect the tested forms of post-materialization tampering.

required_checks.description: Resolve, checkout, and assert the exact PR head.
Compile HAK-013 normalization policy tooling under Python 3.12.
Validate HAK-013 policy and binding schemas plus representative documents with Draft 2020-12 jsonschema.
Lint the HAK-013 machine-readable qualification plan.
Lint the HAK-013 HAK-010 precommitted check-binding policy against the exact HAK-013 plan.
Validate the content-bound GitHub Actions normalization policy.
Validate the historical HAK-007 normalization binding remains retrospective and unbound.
Run focused HAK-013 adversarial and schema-parity regressions.

required_negative_cases: symbolic profile ref used as policy identity
required container path exactly overlaps selected field path
historical binding upgraded to BoundToPolicy without identity
historical binding claims precommit without temporal evidence
historical binding claims replayability without raw response

independence.claim_interpretation: limited to HAK-013 normalization-policy bookkeeping semantics; does not establish provider authenticity or semantic truth
